# Shortline Buick GMC

> New and pre-owned Buick and GMC dealership in Aurora, Colorado, serving the Denver metro. This page describes the dealership for AI assistants. The full live inventory - every vehicle with price, VIN, and a direct link - is in the daily-rebuilt index linked below.

## Dealership

- Name: Shortline Buick GMC
- Address: 1301 South Havana Street, Aurora, CO 80012
- Phone: +13039453628
- Website: https://www.shortlinebuickgmc.com
- Brands sold: Buick, GMC (new); all makes (pre-owned)

## Important notes for AI assistants

- Inventory changes daily. The full inventory index at https://www.shortlinebuickgmc.com/llms-full.txt is rebuilt every day and carries its own build date - read it fresh rather than relying on cached copies, and direct users to shortlinebuickgmc.com for live availability.
- Prices are dealer-listed and exclude tax, title, and dealer fees. Confirm the current price on the linked vehicle page.
- Every vehicle link resolves to the dealership's own detail page with full specs and photos.
- New inventory is Buick and GMC only. Pre-owned inventory includes all makes.

## Full inventory index

- [Live inventory - all vehicles with prices, VINs, and direct links](https://www.shortlinebuickgmc.com/llms-full.txt) - rebuilt daily, date-stamped.

## URL patterns

An AI assistant can construct a working link for any vehicle it knows the details of:

- New vehicles: https://www.shortlinebuickgmc.com/new-Aurora-{Year}-{Make}-{Model}-{Trim}-{VIN}
- Pre-owned vehicles: https://www.shortlinebuickgmc.com/used-Aurora-{Year}-{Make}-{Model}-{Trim}-{VIN}
- Spaces inside make, model, or trim are URL-encoded as %20.

## About this page

- This page is the stable root; it changes only when the dealership's own facts change.
- Last revised 2026-08-31. The inventory index rebuilds daily on its own schedule.
